from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.booking_api import app, BookingCheck

def test_health():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/health')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {'status': 'ok'}

# Normal case
def test_booking_check_normal():
    client = TestClient(app)
    booking_data = {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'startMinute': 300,
        'endMinute': 450,
        'seats': 4
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'durationMinutes': 150,
        'seatMinutes': 600
    }

# Boundary cases
def test_booking_check_boundary():
    client = TestClient(app)
    # Minimum duration and seats
    booking_data_min = {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'startMinute': 0,
        'endMinute': 15,
        'seats': 1
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data_min)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'durationMinutes': 15,
        'seatMinutes': 15
    }

    # Maximum duration and seats
    booking_data_max = {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'startMinute': 1275,
        'endMinute': 1440,
        'seats': 8
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data_max)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'durationMinutes': 165,
        'seatMinutes': 1320
    }

# Invalid inputs
def test_booking_check_invalid():
    client = TestClient(app)
    # Invalid date
    booking_data_invalid_date = {
        'date': '2023-13-05',
        'startMinute': 300,
        'endMinute': 450,
        'seats': 4
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data_invalid_date)
    assert response.status_code == 422

    # Non-multiple of 15
    booking_data_non_multiple = {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'startMinute': 301,
        'endMinute': 450,
        'seats': 4
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data_non_multiple)
    assert response.status_code == 422

    # Too short duration
    booking_data_short_duration = {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'startMinute': 300,
        'endMinute': 310,
        'seats': 4
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data_short_duration)
    assert response.status_code == 422

    # Too long duration
    booking_data_long_duration = {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'startMinute': 300,
        'endMinute': 600,
        'seats': 4
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data_long_duration)
    assert response.status_code == 422

    # Too many seats
    booking_data_many_seats = {
        'date': '2023-10-05',
        'startMinute': 300,
        'endMinute': 450,
        'seats': 9
    }
    response = client.post('/booking-check', json=booking_data_many_seats)
    assert response.status_code == 422
